description: A proof of \(s=t\), together with a proof of the capture-free instance \(A(s)\), yields a proof of \(A(t)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof.equalElim.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {Γ : Finset (L.Formula α)} (φ : L.BoundedFormula α 1) (s t : L.Term α)
  (he : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ (s.equal t))
  (hp :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate φ s)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate φ t)
